summary: Tested the Event Planner water/triathlon tools on backend and UI. Creating any new project was broken: POST /api/planner/events/{eid}/projects returned 500 with IndexError because DEFAULT_LAYERS has 13 layers and COLORS had only 10 colours. T1 fixed this by adding 3 colours to COLORS in planner.py; after that, project creation returns the 3 nautical layers. Backend: 5 of 6 pytest pass. Library: Boe has 12 items, Mezzi nautici 15, plus the new Sicurezza and Transizioni items, and the tags work. GPX with no discipline route returns 400 with a message. GPX/KML/boe.pdf/boe.xlsx return 200, and buoy rows have the right numbers, coordinates, distance from previous and progressive distance. pubblico=true leaves out riservato items. An unknown format returns 400 and unauthenticated calls return 401/403. The one failure: the Control Room planner list has no 'posizione'/'gps_reale' fields. UI: MapTiler returns 403 on preview (known), so the planner map draws nothing at all: no objects, no clicking to select, no drag, no drawing. To test the map, T1 replaced the style.json with an OSM raster style inside Playwright only. App code is unchanged. Working: library search (nuoto/triathlon/boa/SUP/moto d'acqua/soccorso nautico); placing items puts them on the Boe / Mezzi nautici / Transizioni layers; layer visibility hides buoys; buoy number, size (dim 1->3), colour presets, responsabile, pt-lat/lng and 'Spostando la boa...' hint. Boat fields, the GPS status text and riservato also work. Created routes measure 750 tri 749.2 m, 1500 rect 1.50 km, 400 ring 398.9 m, 3800 linear 3.80 km. 1500 with 2 laps gives a 749.2 m lap and 1.50 km total, and changing laps to 3 gives 2.25 km. Also working: arrows toggle, close circuit, adding/deleting/editing points with per-segment distances, Disegna con clic + Termina (disciplina nuoto, arrows on). Linking buoys 1-3 and editing a buoy's lat or dragging it moves the route point and recalculates the distance. Multisport summary with transitions listed separately works. All 5 export buttons download, autosave shows 'Salvato' and everything persists after reload. Gazebo, Ambulanza, Transenne (45 pcs), Rotta di navigazione line and the BOM dialog still work. At 390px the left panel is usable with no horizontal overflow. Bugs found: Duplicate buoy, Reverse direction with linked buoys, Control Room fields missing, new routes created at a fixed point, map blank on preview.

critical.issue: FIXED by T1: IndexError in planner.py create(). COLORS[i] had 10 entries but DEFAULT_LAYERS now has 13, so every new project (not a duplicate) returned 500. Added '#F97316', '#0369A1', '#9333EA' to COLORS.

Not implemented: the features have no 'posizione': 'pianificata' and no 'gps_reale': null (grep finds neither in controlroom_planner.py). Nautical items (Gommone di soccorso, buoys) get suggested 'altro'. NAME_MAP/CAT_MAP has no 'Mezzi nautici', 'Boe', bagnino or moto d'acqua entries.

minor.issue: A buoy not linked to any route is chained after the route's buoys: its 'Da precedente' and progressive distance are added on top of the previous route buoy (e.g. 1511 m, progressive 2002). An independent buoy should probably start its own count or leave distance empty.

Only routes with a disciplina and buoys are exported. Boats, safety points, Rotta di navigazione and Via di evacuazione lines never appear, even in the full (non-public) version. Confirm this is intended.

ui_bugs.component: PropsPanel Duplica on a linked buoy (EventPlanner.duplicate + syncBuoys)
ui_bugs.issue: The copy keeps link_route/link_idx. Two buoys are then tied to the same route point, and syncBuoys moves the point to the copy (SwimA lap 791.6 m -> 787.1 m). After that, moving the original buoy no longer moves the route, and the buoy list shows a duplicate N.3 with 'da precedente' 0. Fix: clear link_route/link_idx (and maybe numero) when duplicating.

ui_bugs.component: WaterProps water-reverse / water-pt-del with linked buoys
ui_bugs.issue: Inverti direzione does nothing on a route that has linked buoys. syncBuoys immediately puts points 0..2 back at the buoy positions, so the coordinates are identical before and after. Deleting or adding points also shifts the indexes, so linked buoys then pull the wrong points. Fix: when reversing or deleting points, remap link_idx on the linked buoys (i -> n-1-i, or shift), or skip the sync for that change.

New routes are placed at proj.center, with Rome [12.4964, 41.9028] as fallback. In a new project, proj.center is null until the map moves, so routes appeared in Rome while buoys placed by clicking sat at about 43.53, 8.10. The route is not created around the visible map centre. Use map.getCenter().

Switching an existing nuoto route to ciclismo or corsa keeps the swim blue (#0284C7), because the colour is only applied when there was no discipline before. The multisport summary and map then show bike/run routes in swim colour.
The buoy label reads '3. · Boa numerata' (joined with ' · '), not 'N. name' as specified.

integration_issues.issue: MapTiler style.json returns 403 (domain restriction, known). PlannerMap adds its feature layers only in 'style.load', so with no OSM fallback the planner map stays completely blank. No objects show, clicks cannot select, drag and drawing give no visual feedback, and the PNG export is empty. Placing items by clicking still creates them. Add the same OSM fallback the Event Map/demo uses.

issues: The header toolbar (Nuovo/Duplica/Rinomina/Archivia/BOM/Import/Riepilogo/filters) wraps onto 5 rows and takes about 45% of the screen height. This is not new, but it leaves little room for the map and panel.
Water routes (Nuoto/SwimA/Run/T1 corridor) and the Rotta di navigazione line appear in the BOM as '1 pz' material rows. Consider leaving disciplina routes and non-material lines out.

action_items: Implement 'posizione': 'pianificata' and 'gps_reale': None in the Control Room planner list (controlroom_planner.py candidates) and map nautical categories to sensible suggestions.
Clear link_route/link_idx when duplicating a buoy.
Remap linked buoy link_idx when reversing or deleting/adding route points (or skip the sync for those changes), so Inverti direzione works on linked routes.
water-create: create the route at the live map centre (map.getCenter()) rather than proj.center or the Rome fallback.
Add an OSM raster fallback to PlannerMap when the MapTiler style fails (403), or fix the allowed domains in MapTiler.
Optional: update the route colour when the disciplina changes; use the 'N. name' label format; leave disciplina routes out of the BOM; make independent buoys' progressive distance separate.
critical_code_review_comments: planner.py: COLORS[i] indexed by the DEFAULT_LAYERS position. It now has 13 colours, but use COLORS[i % len(COLORS)] so it cannot break again when a layer is added.

syncBuoys runs on every change() and always forces route points to the buoy positions. Any geometry edit that does not touch the buoys (reverse, deleting a point, editing the lat/lng of a linked point in the coordinates editor) is silently undone or distorted.
planner_water.export takes 'fmt' as free text and runs the boe branch for anything unknown. It returns 400 at the end, but only after computing buoy_rows. Minor.
WaterTools download(): JSON.parse on a non-JSON error body would throw inside the catch. Minor.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6 after the COLORS fix; 0% before it, since project creation returned 500)
success_rate.frontend: about 85% (core flows work; Duplica and Inverti direzione on linked buoys are broken, routes are created at the wrong place, map blank on preview)

seed_data_creation: T1 created temporary TEST_NUOTO orgs (gold, planner add-on) plus events. The pytest fixture also inserted a test controlroom_purchases doc. Project TEST_NUOTO was archived, then all TEST_NUOTO orgs, their users and the test purchases were deleted (checked: 0 left). No existing projects or data were touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MapTiler 403s on preview and the planner map renders nothing. In Playwright, page.route('**/api.maptiler.com/maps/**') and fulfil with an OSM raster style (needs a glyphs URL). Also add_init_script('window.__PLANNER_RECORDING=true') to get window.__plannerMap, then use map.project() to turn coordinates into pixels for clicks and drags. Dismiss the 'Non ora' demo dialog and the cookie banner after login. Org admin setup: register a TEST_ org, have the SA set the gold plan via PUT /api/platform/saas/orgs/{oid}/admin, then POST /api/addons/planner/events/{eid}/activate. Control Room needs an active controlroom_purchases doc. Delete users via /api/platform/users/{user_id} (the field is user_id, not id). The library comes from GET /api/planner/config -> library.
rca of the issue: Project creation 500: DEFAULT_LAYERS grew from 10 to 13 entries but COLORS stayed at 10, so COLORS[10] raised IndexError in the list comprehension (traceback in backend.err.log, planner.py line 142). Duplicate/reverse bugs: syncBuoys is one-way (buoy -> route point) by index, so duplicating a linked buoy or reordering points fights with the links. Repro: link 3 buoys to a triangle, select the route, click Inverti direzione: the coordinates do not change.
